title: Prohibition-era Chicago: working for Al Capone at the Triangle
summary: He played the Triangle nightclub in Chicago, owned by Al Capone.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Lee, how about Prohibition in Chicago? Oh, yes.

During my time of show business and back in the Prohibition days, I appeared at the various nightclubs there. And I happened to be appearing at the Triangle nightclub there, which at that time was one of the popular nightclubs. And the very well-known gentleman owned the place was Al Capone. And I was working for him, and there was a very successful engagement. And he had a lot of nice people working for him there, but he had some people working for him. It kind of took a liking to me, but I was a little bit afraid of him.
